description: List workspace scheduled posts with from/to timestamps, status, platform, and cursor pagination (maximum 100 per page). Returns items with scheduled_at and approval_status; an empty items array means no matching posts. Approval state is separate from publishing status.

platform.description:
Supported platform identifier. `twitter` and `x` map to the same surface;
responses always normalize to `twitter`. `google_business` posts target
a single Google Business Profile location identified by
`platform_specific.locationName`. `mastodon` accounts are per-instance —
the connected account carries its own `instance_url`.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_list_scheduled_posts
title: List Scheduled Posts
